notes.title: V0.4.7 - Progress Saving
notes.content:
[h2]Progress Saving[/h2]
[list]
[*] A new save system has been added, allowing you to save your progress after each wave. This means you can continue playing from the wave where you left off, even if you quit the game, experience a crash, etc. Note that restarting the game will erase your saved progress, but your stats will be saved. Progress will also be saved if you choose to surrender.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44797202/76c6cf394f1bf9ada453e8251128b367d8c3322a.png[/img]
[h2]Automatic Screen Size Detection[/h2]
[list]
[*] The game now automatically detects your screen size, so option #1 will always match your screen's resolution.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44797202/17cee7dcfcd57465e61515c881bea4be4efdc351.png[/img]
[h2]Increased Base Move Speed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Move speed of enemies and player has been increased.
[/list]
[h2]Increased Endless Mode Difficulty[/h2]
[list]
[*] Endless mode is now more challenging. Regardless of the difficulty level you choose, after wave 30, there will always be two bosses. You will not receive crystals in Endless Mode
[/list]

notes.title: Fight To The Death Release Announcement
notes.content:
Greetings warriors!

We are thrilled to announce that Fight To The Death will officially launch on May 27th, 2024!

[b]Early Access: [/b]The game will be released in early access, meaning you will have the opportunity to experience the game before the full version is complete. This is a great chance for you to participate in the development process, provide feedback, and help us create the best game possible

[b]What to Expect in Early Access:[/b]

[list]
[*][b] 8 Unique Characters:[/b] Choose from a roster of 8 diverse fighters, each with their own distinct fighting styles and abilities.
[*][b] 1 Map[/b]: Battle it out on our first map, a visually stunning arena that will put your skills to the test.
[*] [b]5 Difficulty Levels: [/b]Each level will get more and more difficult
[/list]
Can't wait for you to join us in the arena!  Stay tuned for more updates and get ready to Fight To The Death!

#FightToTheDeath #EarlyAccess

notes.title: Announcement Regarding Release Demo
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We are excited to announce that the demo for Fight To The Death will be released in February!

Here are some details about the demo:

[list]
[*] Release Date: February (Specific date to be announced later)
[*] Content: Includes the first 12 levels of the game, 3 playable characters, and over 20 unique skills.
[*] Note: Save data from the demo will not be carried over to the full game.
[*] Some settings and options will be simplified compared to the full game.
[*] Despite these limitations, the demo is still a great opportunity for you to:
[/list]

Get a better understanding of the game's mechanics.
Help us improve the game by providing feedback and suggestions.
Join our community to stay up-to-date on the latest news and developments:
